metadata.name: US Radar 13F learning watchlist
metadata.purpose: Use selected high-quality macro, multi-strategy, quant, and trading-firm 13F filings as delayed institutional behavior samples for US Radar skills. Do not use as copy-trade signals.
metadata.review_policy: Quarterly review after 13F deadline windows. Extract changes in theme concentration, crowding, put/call hedge signals, catalyst paths, and Radar universe implications.

managers.name: Situational Awareness LP
managers.why_track: Best current sample for AI infrastructure long book plus semiconductor put-hedge structure.

managers.name: Duquesne Family Office LLC
managers.why_track: Druckenmiller-style concentrated macro equity expression; useful for regime fit, concentration, and fast theme rotation.

managers.name: Tudor Investment Corp ET AL
managers.why_track: Risk-first macro trading DNA; useful for trend confirmation, drawdown control, and option/ETF hedge structure.

managers.name: Appaloosa LP
managers.why_track: Tepper-style opportunistic macro equity allocation; useful for cyclical regime and high-conviction sector shifts.

managers.name: Soros Fund Management LLC
managers.why_track: Useful primarily as a reflexivity and regime-change lens, not as a direct stock-picking source.

managers.name: Point72 Asset Management LP
managers.why_track: Large pod-platform behavior can reveal crowded longs/short proxies and theme breadth.

managers.name: Millennium Management LLC
managers.why_track: Huge platform sample; not useful for single-name copy trading, useful for ETF/sector/crowding and breadth signals.

managers.name: Balyasny Asset Management LP
managers.why_track: Useful as a pod-platform cross-check for crowded growth, AI, software, and event-driven exposures.

managers.name: Citadel Advisors LLC
managers.why_track: Large option and equity book; useful for put/call structure and liquidity/crowding clues, not directional copying.

managers.name: Susquehanna International Group LLP
managers.why_track: Option-heavy book; useful for option-interest and volatility-expression patterns, but must be heavily discounted directionally.

managers.name: Jane Street Group LLC
managers.why_track: Useful for ETF, factor, and derivatives structure awareness; weak for fundamental long signals.

managers.name: D. E. Shaw & Co. LP
managers.why_track: Quant and multi-strat breadth sample; useful for factor breadth, not as a high-conviction discretionary signal.

managers.name: Two Sigma Advisers LP
managers.why_track: Quant breadth and factor sample; useful as a weak validation layer only.

managers.name: Coatue Management LLC
managers.why_track: Not macro, but useful for AI/software/internet growth theme validation and candidate discovery.
